A prominent, bright yellow rectangular structure (likely a construction barrier or temporary sign back) stands in the foreground center. To the left, a standard vertical traffic light is suspended from a horizontal mast arm, displaying a red signal. Green highway signs are visible above the road. Other vehicles and roadside vegetation are present in the background.
